rule: Course-site booking links only for publicly playable CO courses without a GolfNow link. Each URL was taken from a link on the course's official website (public tee-time button where member/passholder variants exist), then loaded. Book priority: GolfNow (affiliate, rel=sponsored) > TeeOff > course site (rel=noopener).
notes: TeeItUp booking pages are titled "GolfNow Booking Engine" (GolfNow for Business, formerly Kenna/TeeItUp); EZLinks is also GolfNow-owned (NBC Sports acquired EZLinks 2019). These are course booking engines, not the golfnow.com marketplace affiliate.
EZLinks and Club Prophet serve bot-challenge pages to automation; those links were verified as the course's own official-site link only.

only a B2B referral/ambassador program for referring golf-course operators ($100 call, $1,000 per signed course); no consumer tee-time affiliate found
